VestGen Wealth Partners operates as a multi-entity holding structure. The parent entity (VestGen Wealth Partners Holdings LLC) was incorporated in September 2024; the public RIA platform (VestGen Advisors LLC) launched December 2024. (1) Headquarters address updated to 1 N Franklin St, Suite 1850, Chicago IL 60606 [E-081]

(3) Item 14: Limited pilot program with lead generation platform (SmartVestor Pro — Dave Ramsey) disclosed [E-066, E-081]

(4) Item 5: Material cash AND equity compensation for advisors transitioning their practices to VGA — formal M&A economics [E-081]
